components.name: ds-button-primary
components.description: High-contrast action button for share and navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #f5f0dd; color: #102e35; border: 1px solid #102e35; padding: .6rem .85rem; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #efc84b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: ds-button-secondary
components.description: Quiet secondary action with a visible boundary.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background: transparent; color: #f5f0dd; border: 1px solid rgba(245,240,221,.24); padding: .6rem .85rem; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #efc84b; }

components.name: ds-input-search
components.description: Search field with an editorial underline.
components.css: .ds-input-search { display: flex; gap: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #c1c5b1; padding: .7rem 1rem; } .ds-input-search:focus-within { border-color: #efc84b; }

components.name: ds-chip
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid rgba(245,240,221,.24); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #c1c5b1; padding: .5rem .85rem; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #efc84b; color: #0a2026; }

components.name: ds-quote-card
components.description: Paper surface for the selected line and its evidence.
components.html:
Be curious, not judgmental.
S1 · E8 · The Diamond Dogs
components.css: .ds-quote-card { background: #f5f0dd; color: #112f32; padding: 2rem; } .ds-quote-card blockquote { font: 400 clamp(2.8rem, 6vw, 6.4rem)/.86 Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.09em; }

components.name: ds-evidence-row
components.description: Episode and source metadata attached to a quote.
components.html: Ted LassoS1 · E8 · The Diamond Dogs
components.css: .ds-evidence-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .8rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(17,47,50,.25); padding-top: 1rem; font-size: .8rem; }

narrative.overview: A calm, useful way to find a Ted Lasso line for the moment you are in.
rules: Keep episode evidence beside the quote.
Use original illustrations until licensed stills are available.
Never place eyebrow copy above the hero.
Respect reduced motion and keyboard focus.
dos: Cut copy until every word earns its place.
Link every quote back to its moment.
donts: Do not use gradients or hard offset shadows.
Do not imply original art is an official still.
Do not hide the fan-made disclosure.
